name: Inkeep
long_description:
Inkeep is the only agent platform designed to help both developers and non-developers ship Agent-powered assistants and automations.

Companies like Anthropic, Midjourney, Clay, PostHog, and Postman deploy Inkeep Agents at scale to help with everything from support to sales.

Highlights:
- A No-Code Builder and Developer Framework with full 2-way sync
- Unified search and RAG for knowledge bases, docs, and company data
- MCPs and integrations with your apps, APIs, and software
- Intelligent insights and monitoring over how Agents perform

With Inkeep Agents, enterprises and high-growth teams empower their employees with AI teammates that help get work done and automate repeatable tasks.

Backed by Khosla Ventures, Y-Combinator, Great Point Ventures and leading CEOs and founders.
one_liner: Build AI Agent teammates and automations in code or no-code

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Nick is co-founder and CEO of Inkeep. He previously led devex for a team at Microsoft, focusing on self-serve developer experiences and no-code builders. He studied Business & Computer Science at MIT. Beyond Inkeep, Nick enjoys photography and hiking.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Robert Tran is a cofounder of inkeep. He studied CS & Math at MIT and has an extensive background in tech, including working with government, political organizations, financial firms, and logistics companies. Previously, Robert was an early employee then Head of Engineering at illumis — building software to aggregate thousands of public data sources that are locked in silos. illumis was acquired by ComplySci. Outside of inkeep, Robert is passionate about film & writing.

launches.title: Inkeep - AI support you can trust
launches.tagline: All the AI tools you need to scale support - without losing the human touch
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Nick and Robert - co-founders of [Inkeep](https://inkeep.com/).

### TL;DR

As founders, we know that fast, quality support helps great products stand out.

Inkeep accelerates every step of support with:

🔍 An AI assistant for end-users

🎧 A copilot for support teams

📚 Tools to fix content gaps

Inkeep works with any docs or support platform; see our [showcase](https://inkeep.com/showcase?example=anthropic&tab=aiForCustomers) for examples.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85650&key=user_uploads/1161446/2fab07e8-72a9-4e56-9fb9-e14f38f411c6)

### Problem: today’s tools focus too much on automation

Users of modern products expect two things:

(1) great self-serve experiences

(2) fast human help when they need it

AI support solutions often forget about this and end up feeling like a barrier to getting “real” help. 

### Solution - AI that builds trust

Our approach is simple: build practical tools for every step of the support process with the end-user as the #1 priority.

**Assistant for users**

Inkeep taps into your docs, help center, and other content to provide direct answers to user questions. Our assistant cites its sources, **admits when it doesn’t know**, and hands off to your support channels.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85650&key=user_uploads/1161446/66cc6667-df67-4209-baa3-6ea0e6b38fd3)

**Copilot for support teams**

When your support team needs to step in, our CX copilot:

✍️ Drafts detailed answers

🔗 Links to relevant docs and past tickets

⚡ Summarizes long tickets 

🔔 Suggests to-dos and next steps

[Demo:](https://youtu.be/4_yEpMkdua4)

**Tools to fix content gaps**

The #1 way to improve support over time is to improve your content (or product).\
Inkeep helps close that loop with:

1. [AI reports](https://docs.inkeep.com/analytics/reports) that pinpoint and prioritize gaps in your content.
2. A [Ticket to FAQ](https://go.inkeep.com/ticket-into-faq) tool to create new content from closed tickets.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85650&key=user_uploads/1161446/2a81cc6c-821f-4853-8630-a831a5144135)

### **🙏 Our Ask**

* Want to try an AI assistant powered by your content? Get a [self-serve demo](https://inkeep.com/demo?cta_id=yc_launch).
* Thinking about adding AI to your entire support workflow? [Schedule a call](https://inkeep.com/demo?cta_id=pricing_enterprise_demo_cta).

Socials: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/inkeep), [𝕏.](https://x.com/inkeep_ai)

launches.title: Inkeep - Conversational search for your developer product 💬🔍
launches.tagline: Help developers do more with your product, faster.
launches.body:
> tl;dr: [Inkeep](https://www.inkeep.com/?utm_campaign=yc) provides conversational search for developer-focused companies. We use LLMs to understand a company’s docs, GitHub issues, Stack Overflow questions, and more to answer developer questions and increase customer activation.

### **Our Team:**

Hi YC, we’re [Robert Tran](https://www.linkedin.com/in/robert-tran-profile/) and [Nick Gomez](https://www.linkedin.com/in/edwinngomez/) from Inkeep!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69837&key=user_uploads/1161457/4cbbe838-fb40-4508-89aa-8713f83d7755)

We met eight years ago at MIT as undergrads. After MIT, Nick was a Senior Product Manager working on developer experiences for Microsoft’s identity products. Robert was Head of Engineering at illlumis (acquired), building large-scale data aggregation pipelines for public datasets.

With years of experience building developer-focused products, we are excited to build Inkeep.

### **Problem:** Any blocker or unanswered question is a drop-off point

Developers evaluate a product by how easy it is to get started and use it for their use case. Optimizing this experience is the #1 goal for many developer-focused companies, but it’s hard to do well because:

* Knowledge about the product is scattered across docs, GitHub issues, Stack Overflow, forums, private communities, and more.
* Answering technical issues and questions at scale is hard.
* Developers often prefer to self-troubleshoot.

### **Solution:** Conversational search powered by all your existing content

[Inkeep](https://www.inkeep.com/?utm_campaign=yc) automatically indexes all of a developer tool company’s content with zero effort required. We use fine-tuned LLMs that fully understand your product to power search and chat experiences tailored for developers.

Inkeep is embeddable as a:

* Search bar for your docs
* Chat widget for your app or landing page
* Slack or Discord bot for your community

Your developers can search or ask anything and get answers immediately. And you’ll be able to get insights on what they're getting stuck on.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69837&key=user_uploads/1161457/41100239-1ce3-4e5a-8349-4294e24a237d)


### **Our asks:**

* Interested in adding Inkeep to your developer product? We’d love to [show you a demo](https://calendly.com/nickgomez/inkeep-demo-20mins).
* Connect us with folks who are obsessed with developer experience & activation.

Get in touch at: [founders@inkeep.com](mailto:founders@inkeep.com) \
Learn more at: [Inkeep.com](https://www.inkeep.com/?utm_campaign=yc)
